note: A 2.0 manifest whose STRUCTURE is alien to 1.0 — `site` is a string rather than an object, and `surfaces` replaces bottomNavigation. This is the fixture the layer ordering exists for, and it is the difference between this and version-major-2.json: that one is deliberately structurally valid, so it demonstrates a policy rejection without ever testing the order. This one cannot be described at all unless the version layer runs BEFORE the schema. Validating it against siteskin-1.0.schema.json would produce a pile of structural errors about a format we have already decided not to interpret — and a pile of errors is an invitation to handle them. The only conforming diagnostic is SS-E-VERSION-UNSUPPORTED. Note there is no claim here that a real 2.0 will look like this; the point is only that a browser must not care what it looks like.
